notes.title: Game update
notes.content:
Hello all,

We have updated the build,

Players who experienced the problems with launching - please re-install the game. This should help. 
If you still can't start the game - please write to our "technical problems" thread.

Thank you!

Sincerely,
Growing Grass Studio team
